newsitem.title: USA: Boy critical after teen falls from subway platform.
newsitem.headline: Boy critical after teen falls from subway platform.

text.p: A 5-year-old boy was in critical condition Tuesday after a teenager fell from a subway elevated platform and landed on top of him, police said.
The boy, Anthony Pantoja, suffered multiple wounds and was in "very critical condition" at a hospital, police said. The teenage girl, Erdania Gonzalez, 16, was in serious but stable condition.

"We don't know whether the teenage girl was pushed, slipped or jumped from the elevated subway station at 167th Street and River Avenue in the Highbridge section of the Bronx," a police spokesman said.
Gonzalez landed on top of the boy who was walking with his mother at the time, police said.
